BREAKOUT_MOMENTUM.mechanism: Enters long when price closes above its recent breakout high, above its 200-period moving average, and RSI confirms momentum (one variant additionally requires above-average volume). Exits on an ATR-based stop, a fixed target, or a timeframe-aware maximum holding period, whichever comes first.
BREAKOUT_MOMENTUM.verification_note: The GOLD/1week configuration is this project's single strongest verified result -- its bootstrap confidence interval clears zero on both backtest halves with a real edge over random entry timing (+0.171 train, +0.134 test, docs/statistical_harness_upgrade.md); the SILVER/24h variant, by contrast, is an unverified promising-watchlist forward-test only (docs/metals_phase_a_full_sweep.md).

TREND_PULLBACK.mechanism: Enters long only within an already-established uptrend (50-period average above the 200-period average, price above both), after price has recently pulled back to the 50-period average and closed back above it, with RSI confirming a neutral pullback rather than a reversal. Exits on an ATR-based stop, a fixed target, or a timeframe-aware maximum holding period.
TREND_PULLBACK.verification_note: Honestly thin: BNB/12h's point-estimate expectancy (+0.147 train, +0.243 test) matches every prior measurement, but a stricter bootstrap re-check found the confidence interval crosses zero on both halves at only 57/30 trades -- not yet statistically distinguishable from noise, though it does beat a random-entry baseline by a wide margin (docs/statistical_harness_upgrade.md); the SILVER/24h variant remains an unverified promising-watchlist forward-test.

VOLATILITY_SQUEEZE.mechanism: Watches for a run of unusually narrow Bollinger Bands -- the lowest percentile of their own recent history, sustained for several consecutive candles -- a classic 'coiling' signal that volatility is about to expand. Enters long on a breakout above the high reached during that squeeze, filtered by a trend moving average. Exits on an ATR-based stop, a fixed target, or a timeframe-aware maximum holding period.
VOLATILITY_SQUEEZE.verification_note: Weak: the live SILVER/24h configuration is positive on both backtest halves (+0.168 train, +0.100 test) but both confidence intervals cross zero, and no Volatility Squeeze configuration across the entire 76-config metals sweep reached this project's SURVIVED bar (docs/metals_phase_a_full_sweep.md) -- wired live purely to accrue forward evidence, not as a demonstrated edge.

COINTEGRATION_PAIRS.mechanism: A statistical-arbitrage signal on the BTC/ETH price ratio: when the ratio's z-score moves far enough from its rolling mean, it enters the underperforming leg expecting the ratio to revert. Because Vatican is long-only paper trading, this only simulates one leg of what would be a true market-neutral pairs trade -- its P&L reflects that single leg's own price move, not a genuine hedged spread return.
COINTEGRATION_PAIRS.verification_note: The weakest of this project's three original live survivors under a stricter statistical lens: expectancy is small (0.047 train, 0.003 test), the confidence interval crosses zero on both halves, and -- most tellingly -- its edge over a random-entry baseline is close to zero (+0.003 train, -0.003 test), meaning the z-score-triggered entry timing barely outperforms picking entries at random within the same eligible pool (docs/statistical_harness_upgrade.md).

NEWS_SENTIMENT.mechanism: A forward-test-only signal that scores recent, sufficiently-aged news headlines (at least 2 hours old, to avoid lookahead bias) for bullish or bearish sentiment and reports a directional bias. It has no historical backtest -- no trustworthy backdated headline-timestamp dataset exists -- so it is evaluated purely on live, forward-going evidence.
NEWS_SENTIMENT.verification_note: Cannot be verified in the usual sense: there is no historical backtest to run at all, so this signal has no track record beyond whatever it accrues live going forward -- treat it as unproven by construction, not merely unproven so far.

ORDERFLOW_IMBALANCE.mechanism: Reads live order-book depth (top 20 levels) and compares total bid volume to total ask volume; a sufficiently lopsided ratio, combined with price on the same side of its 20-period moving average, triggers a directional entry. Exits when the imbalance reverts or an ATR-based stop is hit. Order-book snapshots have no historical replay, so this strategy has no backtest at all -- every result comes from live forward-testing only.
ORDERFLOW_IMBALANCE.verification_note: Cannot be verified in the usual sense: order-book depth has no historical replay, so there is no backtest to run -- like NEWS_SENTIMENT, this is unproven by construction, evaluated only on whatever live evidence it accrues going forward.

RANGE_MEAN_REVERSION.mechanism: Only trades while the market is genuinely ranging (ADX below 25, a trend-strength filter checked before every entry) -- inside that regime, it buys when price drops meaningfully below its 20-period average (below the lower Bollinger Band) expecting a bounce back toward the mean, and shorts the mirror-image setup above the upper band.
RANGE_MEAN_REVERSION.verification_note: None of its live configurations reached SURVIVED: GOLD/SILVER 1week and the BTC long-only/confirmation variants are all thin-sample promising-watchlist results whose confidence intervals cross zero (docs/range_mean_reversion_task2_sweep.md, docs/rmr_variant_research_stage1.md) -- the BTC confirmation variant's exit mix does shift meaningfully toward reversion-target hits (68% vs a 32% baseline), a real mechanistic signal, but not yet a proven one at this sample size.

GOLD_SILVER_RATIO_MR.mechanism: Trades mean-reversion in the gold/silver price ratio, which oscillates within a historical band. When the ratio is unusually high -- judged by a rolling 252-session percentile, not a fixed historical band, so it isn't permanently skewed by one-off events like the 2020 COVID spike -- it goes long silver and short gold, expecting the ratio to fall back, and the mirror trade when the ratio is unusually low.
GOLD_SILVER_RATIO_MR.verification_note: Promising but unproven: positive on both backtest halves at the daily timeframe with an adequate sample (N=59/26) and a positive edge over random entry timing in 3 of 4 half-configs, but every confidence interval still crosses zero at this sample size (docs/gold_silver_ratio_mr_results.md) -- classified watchlist, not verified.

PEAD.mechanism: Trades the well-documented 'post-earnings-announcement drift' effect: prices tend to keep drifting in the direction of an earnings surprise for days afterward. Enters the day after a company's earnings announcement in the direction of the surprise, sized by how large that surprise was. Tested only on 7 large, currently-successful companies -- a real survivor-bias caveat that applies to every result this strategy reports.
PEAD.verification_note: The strongest, cleanest result in this project: all 6 tested configurations survived, every bootstrap confidence interval is entirely positive on both halves (never crosses zero), and the edge over a random-entry baseline is large (+0.35 to +0.60) -- but the 7-mega-cap-ticker universe means this is 'PEAD is real on this specific survivor-biased universe,' not a claim about the effect generally (docs/pead_results.md).

DONCHIAN_TREND.mechanism: A bidirectional Donchian-channel breakout strategy: goes long on a breakout above the N-period high, short on a breakdown below the N-period low. Exits use a fixed 2x-ATR stop, a fixed 2:1 reward-to-risk target, and an explicit maximum holding period -- a materially different, bracket-style exit from this family's original long-only, trailing-exit version.
DONCHIAN_TREND.verification_note: GOLD/1week/N20 is the first time this family has cleared every RAW statistical bar this project uses (positive both halves, adequate sample N=144/38, CI clears zero) after four batches of testing -- but grid-shift robustness, the mandatory final check, is structurally impossible at the 1week timeframe (settlement gaps), which is a ceiling on the verification method itself, not a data shortfall -- so it is classified watchlist, deliberately not called 'verified' (docs/donchian_deep_dive_closing_report.md).
